# SparsityAwareInterconnect

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network-on-chip or interconnect design that exploits the sparsity of activations to reduce data movement and communication overhead. Directly addresses TCC's goal of topology-centric efficiency by minimizing bandwidth and energy consumption when sparse features are transmitted between compute nodes.
